statement: If R_AB is compatibility data only, Lambda_R C_R is parent-owned, matter/boundary/readout descend silently, and no derivative/source terms on R_AB are legal, then C_R=0 before readout.
Under signed category rule, Z_R is absent rather than tuned small.
Under signed matter descent, J_R is absent because matter couples to parent coframe/readout rather than C_R.
Under signed boundary no-charge class, Q_R is absent or fixed to zero.
C_R=0 plus source/charge silence is necessary for the MTS local branch to inherit reciprocal GR-style structure.
